title: console on a phone: the pipeline kanban opens on an empty first stage, and a gantt bar has no label while a long title is cut with no ellipsis
body:
domain:ui#5 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbXGpVJHZTXXerMoY4C

This card holds rows 12 and 13 of #27355, HotCRM's browser pass on 18.2.0 (hotcrm#2320). They are carded here under triage's per-row rule. Seat `domain:ui#5` filed it. Seats 1 and 2 confirmed no collision at 2026-10-29T05:56Z.

## Observed (18.2.0, phone width)

| Row | Observed | Report | Suggestion |
|---|---|---|---|
| 12 | On a phone, the pipeline kanban opens on an empty first stage. | [Sales](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/issues/2320#issuecomment-6443461344) S31 | Open on the first non-empty column, or show column counts in a header strip. |
| 13 | On a phone, a gantt bar has no label, and a long campaign title is cut with no ellipsis. | [Marketing](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/issues/2320#issuecomment-6444160853) S19 | Label bars; ellipsize titles. |

## Reading (to be measured)

- **Row 12.** Read code in `ui/packages/plugin-kanban`. A phone kanban shows one column at a time (a horizontal snap scroller or a column picker). It starts at column 0 even when column 0 is empty. The proposed fix is to scroll to, or select, the first column with a card on first load only. Never move the column again after the user has scrolled. Keep the column order unchanged. If the board already has a count strip, a scroll to the first non-empty column is enough.
- **Row 13.** Read code in `ui/packages/plugin-gantt` `GanttView.tsx`. The left task column header is `t('gantt.column.taskName')` (≈L3780, already `truncate`). Measure the row title cells and the bars at 390px:
  - A title cut with no ellipsis means a missing `truncate` / `min-w-0` on a flex child.
  - An unlabelled bar means the bar label is hidden below a width threshold, or is never drawn on narrow layouts. Draw the label inside the bar when it fits, and beside the bar when it doesn't.
- Out of scope: #27386 row 2 (a gantt column-title config key). That is a spec ask and is not part of this card.

## Constraint (ui seat 1)

PR #27388 (#25915 slice 4) retires `ViewSkeleton` and `ShimmerSkeleton`. `KanbanSkeleton`, `FormSkeleton` and `ListSkeleton` stay. Build no new loading state on the two being retired.

## Done looks like

- At 390px, a kanban whose first stage is empty opens with the first non-empty stage in view. A board with cards in stage 1 opens as today.
- At 390px, a gantt bar shows its title, either inside the bar or beside it, and a long title in the task column ends in an ellipsis.
